Name: Reveillon - A New Year's Eve Festival
Author: parrotparrotparrot
Description:
[img width=266]https://i.imgur.com/m9G3joK.pnghttps://i.imgur.com/m9G3joK.png[/img]
Reveillon adds a brand-new New Year's Eve festival to Stardew Valley, celebrated on the mountaintop with the whole town. Gather at The Summit on the last night of winter, share holiday food and drinks, count down to midnight, and watch the sky light up with fireworks. Make a wish for the year ahead and start the new year with a little blessing. [img]https://i.imgur.com/MaR8drK.png[/img]

It's designed to feel like a natural part of the game, same festival flow you already know, just for New Year's Eve.


[img width=273]https://i.imgur.com/DfmTmYf.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.The download contains TWO folders, keep both:
[code]Mods/[CP] Reveillon Festival/[/code][code]Mods/Reveillon Time/[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]A letter will arrive the day before the festival to remind you :)[/*]
[/list]
[img width=263]https://i.imgur.com/bmOV58W.png[/img]
[list]
[*]A full New Year's Eve festival on Winter 28, up at The Summit.[/*]
[*]A midnight countdown (3... 2... 1...) that bursts into a colorful fireworks finale.[/*]
[*]Make a wish: Farming, Mining, Fishing or Luck — and get a small New Year's blessing in the mail.[/*]
[*]A festival shop run by Gus with holiday food and drinks. [img]https://i.imgur.com/IzazUKI.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/owgRg42.png[/img][/*]
[*]New custom items: Sparkling Wine, Hot Cocoa, Cookie Hot Cocoa and Chocotone (Panettone).[/*]
[*]A reminder letter the day before so you never miss it. [img]https://i.imgur.com/9bCe8GP.png[/img][/*]
[/list]
[img width=264]https://i.imgur.com/sGdiPLk.png[/img]
- [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.0.0 or newer


[img width=268]https://i.imgur.com/6mhPWBm.png[/img]
A huge thank you to the Stardew Valley modding community for all the help and guidance throughout the development of this mod. Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MidnightVoyager?gameId=1303]MidnightVoyager[/url] for the valuable tips and for showing me the right way to do things. And finally, thank you to everyone who plays it, I hope you have a wonderful New Year, and enjoy the festival! [img]https://i.imgur.com/gxFFHa5.png[/img]


[img width=266]https://i.imgur.com/RlzIXJ5.png[/img]
[list]
[*]This mod currently includes built-in compatibility for Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), Befriend Marlon and Gunther (BMAG), and Ridgeside Village (RSV). [/*]
[/list]With Stardew Valley Expanded, all of the additional NPCs are fully integrated into the festival. Marlon and Gunther also attend the festival, just as they do when using Befriend Marlon and Gunther.

If you have both SVE and BMAG installed, the compatibility works seamlessly with no conflicts or duplicate NPCs.

For Ridgeside Village, the festival is moved to Winter 27 instead of Winter 28 to avoid conflicting with the Ridgeside festival. To keep this change lore-friendly, Lewis explains that the Ridgeside residents couldn't attend because they were busy preparing for their own celebration, which still takes place on Winter 28.


[img width=270]https://i.imgur.com/I581BZD.png[/img]
[b]Q:[/b] When and where does the festival happen?
A: Winter 28, at The Summit (the mountaintop). Head up there in the evening, like any other festival. A letter reminds you the day before. [img]https://i.imgur.com/rr5t5Jn.png[/img]

[b]Q:[/b] Does it work with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)?
[b]A:[/b] Yes. SVE villagers also attend, and Marlon & Gunther join the festival when SVE is installed.

[b]Q: [/b]Why don't Marlon and Gunther show up for me?
[b]A:[/b] They only attend when you have SVE installed.

[b]Q: [/b]Does it work with Ridgeside Village (RSV)?
[b]A:[/b] Yes. With RSV installed, the festival moves to Winter 27 so it doesn't clash with anything, with a short line from Lewis explaining why.

[b]Q: [/b]Will it clash with my recolor mod?
[b]A:[/b] No. The mod uses the game's own map tilesheets instead of shipping copies, so your recolors are respected.

[b]Q: [/b]Is there any config?
[b]A:[/b] Yes, "MarnieWithMarlon" seats Marnie next to Marlon instead of next to Lewis. It only has an effect with SVE installed, since Marlon only attends the festival with SVE. [img]https://i.imgur.com/x4cM5P2.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/iDxFqaC.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/qj1Z4m1.png[/img]

[b]Q: [/b]Can I make a translation for your mod?
[b]A:[/b] Of course! Feel free to translate as long as you give me credits or put it as required.

[b]Q: [/b]Why are there two folders / why is there a .dll?
[b]A:[/b] The festival is a Content Patcher pack, and "Reveillon Time" is a small SMAPI mod that handles what Content Patcher can't (the 1 AM return, the reminder letter, and the New Year's wish). Keep both folders installed! The festival needs Reveillon Time to work fully.

[b]Q: [/b]How does the New Year's wish work?
[b]A:[/b] During the festival you pick a wish: Farming, Mining, Fishing or Luck. For the whole following spring you get +1 to that skill, like a gentle season-long boost. [img]https://i.imgur.com/LJ12Uuy.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/MdffN85.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/AV4eZAY.png[/img]

[b]Q: [/b]Why was the original mod removed?
[b]A: [/b]Because i used Yri's fireworks asset (firstly as a placeholder), and didn't change it. Every asset is now 100% original

[b]Q: [/b]I installed it but nothing happens on Winter 28.
[b]A:[/b] Double-check that SMAPI and Content Patcher are installed and that the mod loads without errors in the SMAPI console. Then go up to The Summit in the evening on Winter 28.

Manifest.Name: Reveillon Time
Manifest.Description: Returns the player home at 1 AM after the Reveillon festival, instead of the vanilla 10 PM.
